answer: The admission bond is time locked for 15 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in ocean, expire in sable, and dune lists each expiry. An adversary running 85 aliases therefore needs 167 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 4959 identities would post 4324 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
